create_bootstrap_info: create a BootstrapInfo dataclass with process name, manager state, and stream IDs by topic path
create_runner_options: create a RunnerOptions dataclass with optional aligner, bootstrap info, logger type, and logger config
subclass_runner: subclass the abstract Runner class implementing __init__ with a Module and optional RunnerOptions
implement_runner_run: implement the abstract run method in a Runner subclass to execute the module graph
configure_logger_type: configure a RunnerOptions instance with a custom Logger type and LoggerConfig for the runner
